servers.name: ExergyNet MCP Server
servers.description: Read-only MCP lookups for the ExergyNet LNES-03 Solana program and local compute-cost estimator. No private key required. No funds moved.

RPC_URL.description: Solana RPC endpoint. Defaults to public Mainnet-Beta.

tools.name: exergynet_get_program_id
tools.description: Returns the LNES-03 Solana program ID. Static, no network call.

tools.name: exergynet_verify_program
tools.description: Read-only check that LNES-03 program account exists and is executable on Solana Mainnet-Beta.

tools.name: exergynet_get_proof_transaction
tools.description: Returns a reference LNES-03 settlement transaction signature. Static, no network call.

tools.name: exergynet_estimate_gate
tools.description: Local arithmetic comparing external compute cost to settlement cost plus risk margin. No network call.

tools.name: exergynet_open_job
tools.description: Disabled. Always returns a fail-closed message. No signing capability.

servers.name: Vanguard Memory Node (VMN)
servers.description: Local deterministic BM25 memory for AI agents. Offline-first, no API key, SHA-256 content-addressed shards. Same query always returns the same ranked result.

VMN_VAULT_PATH.description: Directory for memory shards. Defaults to ~/.vmn/

LNES17_API_KEY.description: Optional ExergyNet LNES-17 API key for on-chain vault sync.

tools.name: vmn_ingest
tools.description: Store text as a SHA-256 shard with BM25 indexing.

tools.name: vmn_search
tools.description: Full-vault keyword search with ranked results. Deterministic.

tools.name: vmn_recall
tools.description: Retrieve evidence windows from a specific shard by ID.

tools.name: vmn_ingest_file
tools.description: Delta-ingest a growing file without re-ingesting old content.

tools.name: vmn_list
tools.description: List all memory objects in the vault.

tools.name: vmn_delete
tools.description: Remove a shard and its index entries.

tools.name: vmn_rebuild_index
tools.description: Rebuild the full sharded inverted index.

tools.name: vmn_sync_vault
tools.description: Sync shards to ExergyNet LNES-17 for on-chain attestation. Requires LNES17_API_KEY.
